card.title: E01 THE LYRE AND THE SNAKE
card.prompt:
15s · 1080p · 16:9 · ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, NO CUTS. Low wide camera drifting very slowly toward screen-right; no zoom, no cut.

AT DUSK BESIDE A SLOW RIVER IN ANCIENT GREECE. ORPHEUS plays THE LYRE and the wild animals stand still to listen. Then the woman he loves is lost in the tall grass.

REFERENCES, each with a job:
@ORPHEUS: ORPHEUS, an adult man in his late twenties, a Thracian musician: dark curly shoulder-length hair held by a band of olive leaves, short dark beard, plain undyed wool tunic with a rope belt, dark wool cloak over one shoulder with a narrow amber-ochre border stripe, leather sandals. Face, body and clothes only; take nothing of the background.
@LYRE: THE LYRE, his ancient Greek lyre: aged dark-amber wood, a deep rounded body, two curved arms ending in small scrolls, a straight crossbar, seven strings. Shape and wood only; take nothing of the background.
@MEADOW: THE RIVER MEADOW: a wide river meadow at dusk, a slow river bending through tall grass, a few old olive trees on the bank, a long low ridge on the far horizon, one large flat grey stone lying in the tall grass in the left third near the camera. Take the whole place and its light from it.
@ANIMALS: THE THREE WILD ANIMALS: a red-brown roe deer with a pale underside and no antlers, a grey wolf with a pale chest, and a rust-orange fox with a white-tipped tail. Their coats, shapes and sizes only; take nothing of the background.
@EURYDICE: HER DRESS: a long pale undyed linen ancient Greek dress with a long pale veil draped over it. Cloth shape and colour only; she is only ever a dark silhouette with no face and no detail; take nothing of the background.

THE FRAME: Wide and low across THE RIVER MEADOW. ORPHEUS sits on a flat stone in the left third of the frame, in profile, facing screen-right, THE LYRE on his knees, both hands on the strings. A deer, a wolf and a fox stand in the grass in the middle of the frame, all facing him. The river behind them, the low sun gold on the water; tall grass fills the right third. ORPHEUS is no taller than one fifth of the frame height. The only warm light falls on ORPHEUS and THE LYRE.

WHAT HAPPENS:
[0s] ORPHEUS plays THE LYRE, his fingers moving across the strings, eyes half closed, face toward screen-right. The deer, the wolf and the fox stay motionless, ears forward, facing him.
[6s] Far away in the tall grass at the right, a woman's dark silhouette in a long pale dress walks toward screen-left, toward ORPHEUS, seen from the side, no face, no detail.
[9s] A thin dark snake slides through the grass toward her feet in one S-curve. The silhouette stops, then sinks below the tops of the grass and is gone; only the grass sways where she stood. At 11 seconds ORPHEUS stops playing, lifts his head and looks toward screen-right, hands raised off the strings.
[12s] Hold: everyone stays where they are, no speech, no singing, no new action; only wind in the grass and the slow river.

overall_soundscape: only the sounds of the place and of ORPHEUS's own lyre: slow plucked notes of one ancient lyre until 10 seconds, wind in tall grass, slow river water, soft animal breath. No voices, no speech, no singing. After 12 seconds only wind and river.
non_diegetic_music: none.

card.title: E02 THE LAND OF THE DEAD
card.prompt:
15s · 1080p · 16:9 · TWO SHOTS JOINED BY ONE HARD CUT at 5 seconds. Shot one is static. Shot two is one continuous take with a slow pull-back; no zoom.

A DARK ROOM LIT BY ONE LAMP, THEN THE LAND OF THE DEAD. Two aged hands rest on an open book. Then ORPHEUS stands before the king and queen of the dead, plays, and the king lets him go.

REFERENCES, each with a job:
@TELLER_ROOM: THE TELLER'S ROOM: a dark room, a small oil lamp on a worn wooden table, a tall shelf of identical leather-bound books with blank spines, two aged hands with ink-stained fingertips and one plain iron ring on the right ring finger resting on an open book. Take the whole place and its light from it.
@ORPHEUS: ORPHEUS, an adult man in his late twenties, a Thracian musician: dark curly shoulder-length hair held by a band of olive leaves, short dark beard, plain undyed wool tunic with a rope belt, dark wool cloak over one shoulder with a narrow amber-ochre border stripe, leather sandals. Face, body and clothes only; take nothing of the background.
@LYRE: THE LYRE, his ancient Greek lyre: aged dark-amber wood, a deep rounded body, two curved arms ending in small scrolls, a straight crossbar, seven strings. Shape and wood only; take nothing of the background.
@THRONES: THE THRONES: two tall rough-cut black stone thrones side by side in a dark hall, THE KING OF THE DEAD seated on the left one and THE QUEEN OF THE DEAD on the right one, both in plain black stone crowns and long black robes, ash-grey skin. Take the thrones, the two seated figures and the hall's light from it.
@KING: THE KING OF THE DEAD, a tall pale adult man in his forties, ash-grey skin, stern lean face, short dark hair, plain black stone crown, long black robe with a high collar. Face and clothes only; take nothing of the background.

THE FRAME: SHOT ONE: close shot across a worn wooden table in THE TELLER'S ROOM: two aged, weathered hands, no face and no body, rest on an open book; the small oil lamp at screen-right; the shelf of blank books dark behind. SHOT TWO: a vast dark cavern hall. ORPHEUS stands in the left third of the frame, in profile, facing screen-right, THE LYRE in his hands. At screen-right on two dark stone thrones sit THE KING OF THE DEAD, a tall pale man with ash-grey skin, a plain black stone crown and a long black robe, and THE QUEEN OF THE DEAD beside him, a pale woman with ash-grey skin, long black hair, a plain black stone crown and a long dark robe; both face three-quarter toward screen-left, toward ORPHEUS. ORPHEUS is no taller than one quarter of the frame height. The only warm light falls on ORPHEUS and THE LYRE; the thrones sit in cold verdigris dark.

WHAT HAPPENS:
[0s] SHOT ONE: the aged hands turn one page of the open book, slowly. The lamp flame flickers; dust drifts in the lamplight. The camera does not move.
[5s] HARD CUT to SHOT TWO, wide and low: ORPHEUS walks in from screen-left through the hall toward the thrones, the camera pulling back slowly in front of him.
[8s] ORPHEUS stops in front of the thrones, lifts THE LYRE and plays. The stern face of THE KING OF THE DEAD softens and he lowers his chin. At 11 seconds THE KING lifts one hand toward screen-left and nods once; ORPHEUS lowers THE LYRE.
[12s] Hold: everyone stays where they are, no speech, no singing, no new action; only a low cold wind and the last faint note of THE LYRE.

card.title: E03 THE LOOK BACK
card.prompt:
15s · 1080p · 16:9 · ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, NO CUTS. Camera at the side of the stair, tracking slowly toward screen-right and rising with him; no zoom, no cut.

A DARK STAIR OUT OF THE LAND OF THE DEAD, THE LAST STEPS BELOW THE DAYLIGHT. ORPHEUS climbs with a silhouette behind him. He turns to look back, speaks one word, and she dissolves.

REFERENCES, each with a job:
@STAIR: THE STAIR: a narrow rough-cut wet stone stair climbing steeply through a dark cavern toward a small opening of pale daylight at the top. Take the whole place and its light from it.
@ORPHEUS_ASHEN: ORPHEUS after the climb out of the cave, an adult man in his late twenties: the same face, curly hair and short dark beard as always, the olive-leaf band slipped a little to one side, the plain wool tunic and the dark cloak with its amber-ochre border stripe now dusted grey with cave dust and damp at the hem, a faint grey smudge on one cheek, leather sandals. Face, body and clothes only; take nothing of the background.
@LYRE: THE LYRE, his ancient Greek lyre: aged dark-amber wood, a deep rounded body, two curved arms ending in small scrolls, a straight crossbar, seven strings. Shape and wood only; take nothing of the background.
@EURYDICE: HER DRESS: a long pale undyed linen ancient Greek dress with a long pale veil draped over it. Cloth shape and colour only; she is only ever a dark silhouette with no face and no detail; take nothing of the background.

THE FRAME: Side view of THE STAIR, climbing from the lower left up to the pale opening of daylight at the upper right. ORPHEUS climbs toward screen-right and upward, THE LYRE hanging from one hand, his shoulder toward the camera. Two steps below him at screen-left, a woman's dark silhouette follows, a pale outline in the mist, no face, no detail. ORPHEUS is no taller than one third of the frame height. The only warm light falls on ORPHEUS and THE LYRE; the daylight opening is cold and pale.

WHAT HAPPENS:
[0s] ORPHEUS climbs the wet steps toward screen-right and upward, steady, THE LYRE in his hand; the silhouette follows two steps behind him, silent. Mist drifts across the stone.
[5s] Near the top, daylight reaches ORPHEUS. He slows and stops; his shoulders tighten and his free hand closes. The silhouette stays two steps behind, motionless.
[8s] ORPHEUS turns his head and shoulders toward screen-left and looks down at the silhouette, his face in three-quarter profile toward screen-left, lips visible. From 9.5 to 10.6 seconds he speaks one word, his eyes on her, not on the camera.
[11s] The silhouette comes apart like smoke and drifts down the stair. ORPHEUS reaches toward screen-left with his free hand; his fingers close on empty mist.
[12s] Hold: ORPHEUS stays where he is, no speech, no new action; only drips of water and a thin wind from the opening.
